title: Strategic signal brief for monthly roadmap scrub and exec asks
creator: Priya Khatri
description: Purpose: Prepare a concise, action-oriented briefing packet for the monthly roadmap scrub with execs and GTM partners. Deliverables: 1) 6-slide exec packet with topline progress vs OKRs, two highest-risk asks with mitigation lanes, and three cross-org decisions; 2) Signal heatmap (qual + quant) showing initiative momentum and quality regressions; 3) Decision register for the board/execs with explicit fallback triggers and cost delta estimates. Scope: runtime perf efforts, Dedicated autoscaling, Private deployment compliance tasks, and Console UX rollouts that influence customer SLAs. Success criteria: packet approved by PLs and Eng leads, 2 prioritized asks with committed owners, and one A/B rollout decision locked for next cycle.
